claims.quote: Ontario's oldest brew pub — celebrating its 40th anniversary in April 2026; 26 beers and cider on tap with two on cask; traditional wood smoker on the back patio producing authentic BBQ
claims.ordinal: oldest in Ontario — a superlative nothing else can claim

claims.quote: Dragon's Breath — Bitter/Ordinary, 3.7 on ~1,400 ratings; 'the Dragon's Breath cask ale really enjoyable' — house cask tradition
claims.note: Heritage cask-and-BBQ brewpub: the reason to go is the INSTITUTION, not style excellence. Experience-led, beer honest.
